# Workflow

This page documents the generic project workflow without conversation content.
The drafting skill and generic QMD template support German thematic summaries
for personal recall from fallible university Whisper-v3 JSON.

All conversation files, including authoritative QMD and fictional trial data,
remain permanently unversioned and off GitHub. Deliberately mapped ignored
repository storage is allowed; persistent files default to external sync and
temporary files to ignored device-local temp/conversation-work/.
DOCX is the initial review format; accepted corrections return to authoritative
unversioned QMD. Clarification precedes synthesis;
actual date/participants provide orientation, and structure follows the content.
Useful highlights and recaps are optional, with compact source footnotes.
Review the provisional template after the first test and revise it by the second.
The first fictional conversation trial remains pending.

Repository introductions and retained guides contain binding storage/access
rules. The recorded first draft/export awaits review and a completed correction
round-trip; no publication has occurred.
